findings.claim: Collision retries must use up to three distinct server-generated UUID candidates before exhaustion.
findings.observed: Both DynamoDBCaseClientRepository.create_case and MockCaseClientRepository.create_case count each uuid4() result as an attempt without rejecting a duplicate candidate, so repeated generator output can retry the same occupied key three times and raise allocation failure after only one distinct candidate.
findings.rationale: The caller-supplied plan explicitly specifies at most three distinct generated IDs. Counting duplicate candidates as separate collision attempts violates that strategy and can fail a create that should proceed to another candidate; the supplied tests cover three different IDs but not duplicate generator output.
findings.required: Track generated candidates so collision retries operate on distinct UUIDs, while preserving a bounded fail-closed strategy, and cover duplicate generator output in both adapter behaviors.
